record.question: The truth had been _______ into them.
record.explanation: Answer B: drummed. “The truth had been drummed into them” means it was repeatedly taught or impressed upon them. Independent check: “Drum something into someone” means to teach or impress it by repeated instruction; “the truth had been drummed into them” is the idiom. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/choreomania; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/drum. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
